messages:
maria: Following up from the postmortem — brief windows of 401s from token-validate + missing audit entries. Need clear owners, short-term mitigations, and a durable detector.

sam: I'll own client mitigations. Plan: SDK retry with jitter (max 3) + feature flag for canary. Will file INF-25701. ETA Fri.

liam: I'll own audit durability. Hypothesis: write buffer overflow when cache churns. Plan: add local disk spill + metric dropped_audit_events_total, and alert if drops > 5 in 10m. File SRE-10533.

carla: Security to check signing key and IAM changes. If rotation or perm drift required, I'll coordinate rollout and SEC ticket. Quick check shows last rotation 2025-08-03; will update.

maria: Short checklist and deadlines:
- sam INF-25701 (SDK retries) due 2026-03-28
- liam SRE-10533 (audit buffer + alert) due 2026-04-04
- carla SEC-6310 (perm/key review if needed) due 2026-03-26

infra-bot: scheduled recurring follow-up "token-validate-followup" weekly on Wed 09:00 UTC for 3 weeks.

maria: Please drop PR/JIRA links and 1-line status updates here. We'll close after PRs merged and alert quiet for 48h. :thumbsup:
